name: CyBe GR (Gantry Robot)
summary: Large stationary gantry 3D concrete printer (six columns, three beams, about 13 t) for printing modular room units and large elements in a factory, which are finished off-site and set on site.

germany.statusNote: EU maker (Netherlands) sells directly through its sales team and contact form, with a published 'price from' figure ex works; no German distributor found. CyBe says it distributes worldwide and the printers are modular for transport.

priceEur.note: 'Price from €485,000*' with '*Price ex works, based on standard dimensions'; tax basis not stated. The FAQ on the same page gives 'CyBe G (Gantry) €285,000 Ex Works'.

sellers.name: CyBe Construction B.V.
sellers.note: Oss, Netherlands; the contact form has the option 'I want to buy a printer'. Price is ex works, standard dimensions; transport and import taxes are paid by the buyer.

specs.label: Weight
specs.quote: Consisting of 6 columns and 3 beams, the CyBe GR weighs close to 13 tons.

specs.label: Speed, horizontal
specs.quote: At 500 mm/s for horizontal movement and 40 mm/s for vertical movement

specs.label: Speed, vertical
specs.quote: At 500 mm/s for horizontal movement and 40 mm/s for vertical movement

specs.label: Operating crew
specs.conditions: stated for CyBe printers in general
specs.quote: The printer is operated by just two persons

notes: Fixed gantry; prints anywhere inside its frame, in a factory hall.
CyBe uses it for its PPVC method: room modules printed and fitted out off-site, then set on site.
Needs a mortar mixing and pumping unit (CyBe Mortar Gantry).
